label: OWNER-REPORT scores; geometric covariates measured here

regression.formula: score ~ 1 + f0 + f1 + f2 + clump + log10(D)
regression.note: f0+f1+f2+f3 = 1 so f3 is dropped (perfect collinearity); the f0 coefficient is the effect of moving mass from >12 px to within 3 px of a catalogued fault.

N_bounds_per_file.derivation: official DTI = A/(0.2A + 0.2FP + 0.8N) with A = TP_w <= min(D, N). A <= N gives the lower bound, A <= D gives the upper bound. Bounds hold for every file; the tightest are reported.
